note: AC-SP89-4 buildable severance/skew/outage/restart/rebuild fixture matrix. Every entry joins the typed vocabulary an owner already committed to its own release evidence (Omniscience severance-fixtures.json; Barbarossa's durability_test.go/backup_pw0_test.go/sp86_consumer_test.go/sp86_decoupling_test.go as documented in docs/runbooks/management-readonly-release.md; Portal's classify_sp86_pin/classify_sp87_pin and AC-SP88-3 composition isolation as documented in its own runbook). This matrix is a structural/typed fixture check validated by tests/test_management_readonly_v1.py -- it does not execute a live component and is not a substitute for AC-SP89-3's real environment e2e matrix, which requires a named non-production environment this task does not have.

fixtures.description: reference_now minus request.evidence_cut exceeds request.max_age_seconds; expired freshness cannot be silently promoted to current truth.

Consumer's pinned contract_major, schema_revision_pin, or producer_manifest_digest_pin no longer matches the live manifest; three independent skew reasons (contract_major_mismatch, schema_digest_mismatch, producer_manifest_mismatch) all fail closed.
Evidence source is unreachable (raises on health(), or health().healthy == false); consumer must not treat a severed producer as an empty-but-valid answer.

Consumer's omniscience-mcp-read-v1 token profile has expired or been revoked before the request boundary; a revoked token cannot be treated as still-authorized-but-stale. Mapped into the outage family: a revoked-auth producer is unreachable-for-this-consumer in the same way as an unhealthy producer.

fixtures.description: Barbarossa copies Omniscience's severance-fixture kit byte-for-byte and asserts every fixture (including freshness_expiry) maps to Degraded=true, UsableForFacts=false, Coverage="none" through its own consumer -- never healthy/empty/cached-current.
VerifySp86ReleasePin fails closed (AbsenceIncompatible, ReasonSp86PinMismatch) on any single-field drift of the pinned SP-86 release; never a silent match.

Evaluates the exact Reliability vertical once, then again after simulating each of loss/token-expiry/freshness-expiry/contract-skew/PII-block, and asserts the resulting AvailabilitySnapshot integrity digest and all three typed conditions stay byte-identical every time -- SP-86 context severance never touches authoritative Reliability state.

Proves restart, duplicate delivery, and lease-expiry/stale-writer fencing: a writer holding an expired lease is rejected and cannot mutate authoritative state after a fresher writer has taken the lease.

Projection rebuild proceeds from durable state; a sealed BackupExport is JSON-marshaled, written to disk, read back in a fresh process scope, and restored -- the restored case's full transition history is byte-identical (CasKey-for-CasKey) to the pre-backup ledger, and both records independently re-verify their own integrity seal.

A mutable/skewed/partial candidate pin classifies as incompatible; a Node-backed/TypeScript-production provenance claim also classifies as incompatible regardless of digest match; never a silent match.

When no owner-pin candidate is presented at all, classification is unknown -- never a favorable default. A missing/incompatible input on one owner axis never blanks another independent panel (CMC/Privacy/CV/runtime-profiles stay independently severable, AC-SP88-3).
